description: This Java class defines an event for capturing and calculating the frame rate of an Android application during testing, by executing system commands and parsing their output.

classes.name: MonkeyGetAppFrameRateEvent
classes.description: A class representing an event to measure app frame rate by executing system commands and processing their output.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frame rate given total frames and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Writes the calculated average frame rate to a log file.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Parses the output of the dumpsys command to extract the number of frames rendered.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the system command to get frame info, parses output, and updates frame count and timing.
